questions.text: The same turn is used at every step. Which option is the next figure in the sequence?
questions.explanation: Option A. Each figure turns 90° clockwise about C to make the next frame. Check all three visible transitions, then apply the same quarter turn to frame 4. After four quarter turns the figure returns to its first orientation. Follow both the outline and the solid dot; do not flip the figure.

questions.text: The same turn is used at every step across each row, and the same turn is used down each column. Which option completes the bottom-right cell?
questions.explanation: Option A. Across every row, each figure turns 90° clockwise about its own C. Down every column, each figure makes a half turn (180°). From the bottom-middle cell, turn 90° clockwise; from the middle-right cell, make a half turn. Both give the same bottom-right figure. Follow both the outline and the solid dot; do not flip the figure.
